errors.what: The dotted inhibin loop ends in a flat bar on the FSH arrow below the anterior pituitary.
errors.why_wrong: Inhibin reduces FSH production and secretion at the anterior pituitary. Placing the bar on the outgoing FSH pathway may suggest that inhibin acts on FSH after its release.

errors.what: The diagram and legend labels are very small, while most of the image below the figure is empty.
errors.why_wrong: Several labels are difficult to read at the displayed size, reducing the figure’s usefulness for study.

verdict: The feedback directions and hormone relationships are broadly correct, and the figure covers the caption. Move inhibin’s inhibitory bar to the anterior pituitary and enlarge the diagram and labels.
